critique_history.assessment:
- Both antennae visibly float above the head; extend their bases into the cephalothorax and make every section continuous.
- Numerous antenna rings and leg collars are detached and scattered around the body; remove or correctly attach them.
- Walking legs resemble a dorsal rib cage; anchor them beneath the compact thorax and angle them outward/downward.
- The tail fan has large open gaps and a loop-like silhouette; replace it with overlapping solid fan blades.
The model clearly captures the clawless spiny lobster with prominent curved antennae, broad rounded abdominal segments, compact body, pointed walking legs, and attached tail fan.
